reviews.title: Use to be free
reviews.text: I use to love this app when it was free to use. It’s sad there is no free option anymore. :(

reviews.title: Paid for a lifetime membership
reviews.text: I paid a one time life time membership years ago and that lifetime membership is no longer available to me and I now have to pay a continuous subscription fee after being forcefully logged out of the app after it crashed. Sucks that everything is a subscription service anymore. Highly disappointed.

reviews.title: I’m too young to pay for it myself so I have to uninstall it :( disappointed
reviews.text: Have to pay for it (at least on my device)

reviews.title: Music tempo
reviews.text: I bought premium literally only for them to change tempo to the music based on whether I was walking running or sprinting and it doesn’t even do as advertised. I can’t get any music to change tempo!!! Wtf!!

reviews.title: Убрали возможность пользоваться бесплатной/ограниченной версией
reviews.text: Обновлений никаких нет уже год, деньги за подписку берут, а ничего нового не добавили. Убрали возможность пользоваться приложениями с ограничениями (нет бесплатной версии(
